_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). The NEW Veer Cruiser infant car seat adapter (available May 2023) that added Clek support. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Veer Cruiser Infant Car Seat Adapter (Cybex / Maxi-Cosi / Nuna / Clek)
seatBrandsSupported: Cybex, Maxi-Cosi, Nuna, and Clek — the NEW (May 2023) adapter EXPLICITLY adds Clek and lists the Clek Liing. Nuna PIPA family, Cybex Aton, Maxi-Cosi Mico. (Note: Stokke PIPA by Nuna not supported.)

status.clekNote: Clek's list flags this as the 'NEW Clek/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna' adapter, available May 2023 — the earlier Cruiser adapter did not list Clek, so the current/new part is the correct one for a Clek Liing.

install.pieces: single-piece adapter (one unit; ships as (1) Infant Car Seat Adapter)
install.notes: Clicks onto the Cruiser / Cruiser XL / Cruiser City frame; car seat can face parent or forward, over front or back seat. Veer notes the adapter is intentionally a tight fit and may require a firm push to seat/remove. Works on any Cruiser model (All-Terrain or City).

notes: This is the NEW Veer Cruiser adapter (available May 2023) that added Clek/Liing compatibility to the existing Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna support; serves veer-cruiser (both 2-seat Cruiser and 4-seat Cruiser XL). No printed part number on Clek's list or Veer's page — partNumber null. $79 at Veer DTC and Baby Cubby (Baby Cubby sold out, restock est. mid-July 2026). Single-piece, tool-free.
